english.title: Breach a criminal behaviour order

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: anti social behaviour crime and policing act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY ACT PERFORMED..) which you were prohibited from doing]_
(B)_[failed to **(..SPECIFY ACT NOT PERFORMED..) as required]_

by a criminal behaviour order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER WAS MADE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30(1) and (2) of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
breached a criminal behaviour order

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) This offence should only be used in relation to breaches of orders before the Sentencing Act 2020 came in force on 1st December 2020. For breaches from that date, see offence H22091.
